title: Session Start Protocol
description: Every agent session must detect the user role and check environment capabilities before proceeding.

statements.label: Confirm the session-start hook ran
statements.requirement: Before its first durable step the agent MUST confirm that the checkout's session-start hook ran, and MUST run its commands by hand, from the checkout root and in order, when it did not. The hook runs only when a session starts inside the checkout, so a repository attached or cloned partway through a session, or a session opened outside the checkout, never runs it. The skill remote-mount, section "When the session-start hook did not run", gives the commands and the checks.

successCriteria.criterion: Before the agent reports any mounted path, state graph or platform tool as unavailable, the declared state graphs and remote-mounted layers are on disk, either because the hook ran or because the agent ran its commands by hand.

statements.label: Detect user role
statements.requirement: The agent MUST determine the user's role at session start by checking identity sources against the role assignment table.
statements._comment: Was `capability:role-detection`, which has never existed. Capabilities in this layer are ENVIRONMENT PROBES — `detection: { method: "command" }` — and role detection is not one: it is the actor registry plus `role-assignments.json` read against the session's identity. The skill that documents that mechanism is what an agent opens to satisfy this statement. Corrected 2026-09-18, bean m4zg.

successCriteria.criterion: The agent session log records the resolved user role derived from role-assignments.json.

statements.label: Check environment capabilities
statements.requirement: The agent MUST probe for all capabilities referenced by skills the user's role can access.

successCriteria.criterion: Capability probes execute for all capabilities required by skills available to the detected role.

statements.label: Check open todos
statements.requirement: The agent SHOULD check for open todos and present a summary to the user.

successCriteria.criterion: The session initialization output includes an open todo count or work plan summary.
